meta.title: Dev flow
meta.description: A right-sidebar panel for multi-repository development: overview, tasks, slots, baselines, and agents. Turn on the workflow switch above the conversation so the lead session dispatches implementation and acceptance to subagents through the bundled dev-flow skill. Tasks run in their own worktrees and df-task/<id> branches, state lives in .dev-flow/ at the workspace root, and the panel requires a session opened at that root.
